جَسَّاسٌ : see جَاسُوسٌ ―
-b2- (tropical:) The lion that marks his prey with his claws: (K, TA:) or one that traverses a land. (Aboo-Sa'eed El-Yeshkuree, TA.) ―
-b3- الجَسَّاسَةٌ A certain beast, that will be in the islands, that will search after news, or tidings, and bring them to Ed-Dejjál [or Antichrist]. (Lth, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
